definitions.explanation: A state of physical exhaustion, loss of appetite, and general malaise caused by prolonged exposure to summer heat and humidity. A common condition in Japan's hot and humid summers. Composed of 夏 (summer) + バテる (to be worn out).

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}バテ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have no appetite due to summer fatigue.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}バテ⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Let's eat well so we don't get summer fatigue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{夏|なつ}バテ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きなく→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Every year when August comes, I get summer fatigue and lose all motivation.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as a noun ({夏|なつ}バテ) or as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({夏|なつ}バテ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Symptoms include loss of appetite, fatigue, and difficulty sleeping. Very common topic in Japanese summer conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夏|なつ}バテ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to suffer from summer fatigue)
- {夏|なつ}バテ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ / ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ (preventing summer fatigue)
- {夏|なつ}バテ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (measures against summer fatigue)
- {夏|なつ}バテ⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (a touch of summer fatigue)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's humid summers make {夏|なつ}バテ a widely shared experience. Traditional remedies include eating ⟦{鰻|うなぎ}→鰻：06105_unagi⟧ (eel) on ⟦{土用|どよう}→土用：27533_doyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丑|うし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (midsummer day of the ox) and consuming ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧ (pickled plums) for energy.
